|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on opponent's just deployed card with a maintenance cost (opponent must lose 1 Force and you may retrieve 1 Force). That card is power - 3 and may not apply its ability toward drawing battle destiny. During opponent's draw phase, opponent must lose 1 Force or place that card out of play. [Immune to Control]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Breached Defenses (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on opponent’s just deployed [Maintenance] card; opponent loses 1 Force and you may retrieve 1 Force. That card may not apply its ability toward drawing battle destiny, is power -3, and gains (in addition to its own maintenance cost): “★Lose 1 Force, or ☠.” (Immune to Control.)” '''What changed:''' “opponent's” → “opponent’s”; “card with a maintenance cost (opponent must lose” → “[Maintenance] card; opponent loses”; “Force).” → “Force.”; removed “is power - 3 and”; “destiny. During opponent's draw phase, opponent must lose” → “destiny, is power -3, and gains (in addition to its own maintenance cost): “★Lose”; “Force” → “Force,”; “place that card out of play. [Immune” → “☠.” (Immune”; “Control]” → “Control.)”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards4.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown); page 4, slip 31. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
